name: Create Unit Photo
description: Upload a photo to a unit.

pathParams.name: UnitId
pathParams.description: The unit to which the photo will be attached. Note: Unit photos cannot be created through this endpoint if the unit belongs to a Unit Type that uses Unit Type Photos.

attributes.name: File
attributes.description: The file's bytes, sent as a multipart file part named "File" with its filename and MIME type. Do NOT put a path string here: pass the local file via call_endpoint's `file` argument, e.g. file: { path: "C:/scans/invoice.pdf" }.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit photo
